description: Remove all wd_menu WhatsApp template send logic from amplify/functions/messaging/whatsapp-calling/handler.py and replace the two live post-call sends with one plain-text catch-all. The wd_menu template was DELETED at Meta by the owner, so every send referencing it fails today - this is a live bug, not just cleanup. Deletes the already-dead _send_ivr_menu entirely and strips the template from _send_call_whatsapp_notification and _handle_post_call_sip, including their text fallbacks. Explicitly does NOT touch the IVR button menu (_SHARED_IVR_MENU, IVR_MENUS, IVR_DEFAULT_MENU, IVR_RESPONSES, _get_ivr_menu, ivr_callback/ivr_support/ivr_ai) - the owner said leave the IVR buttons alone - and does not delete the Lambda. Independent of FEAT-001: different file, no shared symbol, and the two MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT constants are deliberately separate module-level copies because the handlers share no module.
steps: Re-derive line numbers: run `.venv/bin/python .scratch/menu_extents.py` (its second half prints the current ranges for this file). Then run `git status --short` as its OWN command; if this handler shows an uncommitted modification it belongs to another session - stop and report.
Record the baseline: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_calling.py tests/test_outbound_whatsapp.py tests/test_notifications_domain.py -q` and note the pass count.

Add module constant MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT = "We're refreshing our menu - please type *menu* and we'll help you." next to IVR_SMS_CONTENT (around line 1471). Use this exact copy, verbatim - it must match the string FEAT-001 added to the inbound handler.

Add helper _send_menu_placeholder_text(meta_id, to_phone, request_id='') -> str. It posts {'messaging_product': 'whatsapp', 'recipient_type': 'individual', 'to': to_phone.lstrip('+'), 'type': 'text', 'text': {'body': MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT}} through the existing _meta_api_call(f'{meta_id}/messages', 'POST', payload, phone_number_id=meta_id) and returns the Meta message id or ''. Use _meta_api_call, NOT _send_via_aws: the returned wamid must belong to meta_id's own conversation, which is the precondition _react_thumbs_up documents at 972-1008, so the existing auto-thumbs-up keeps working. Its docstring must record that this is a plain text send and therefore needs an open 24-hour window - the deleted wd_menu template was what allowed a send outside it, so a post-call message to someone who never messaged the business will now fail. That is expected, it is logged, and both call sites already treat the send as non-blocking.

Delete _send_ivr_menu entirely (2012-2072), including its plain-text fallback via _send_via_aws and its _update_call_status(call_id, 'ivr_menu_sent', {'ivrTemplate': 'wd_menu', ...}) write. Re-confirm first that `grep -n '_send_ivr_menu' <file>` shows only the def line - planning measured it as dead code with no caller, and _auto_pickup_and_play (1703-1814) does not call it.

Rework _send_call_whatsapp_notification (2565-2712): delete the template_msg dict (the wd_menu template with the VIDEO header parameter) and replace both the first send and the 2-second retry with _send_menu_placeholder_text(meta_id, caller_phone, request_id). KEEP: the is_waba2 / send_from fan-out (WABA1 only for a WABA1 call, WABA1+WABA2 for a WABA2 call), the retry, the _store_notification_to_inbox call with content changed to MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT (drop the '[wd_menu template via ...]' prefix), the _react_thumbs_up call, the error logging, and the CallNotifications put_item. Set whatsappTemplate to 'none' rather than '' in that put_item. DROP the now-false 'troubleshoot' text that claims 'wd_menu IS approved on {label}'.

Rework _handle_post_call_sip (1011-1168): delete the template_msg dict and replace the per-WABA template send loop with _send_menu_placeholder_text(meta_id, caller_phone, request_id). DELETE the 'all wd_menu sends failed, falling back to text' block that sent IVR_SMS_CONTENT via _send_via_aws - there is no template to fall back from any more and the placeholder is already the text. KEEP: the _is_postcall_wa_enabled() gate, send_from, first_msg_id, the _react_thumbs_up call, the put_call_breadcrumb call, the WhatsAppOutboundTable store (content becomes MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT, no '[wd_menu template]' prefix), the post-call SMS step (_send_disconnect_sms) and the post-call RCS step.

Before renaming any log event, check whether anything consumes it: grep scripts/ and docs/ for call_wa_template_sent and call_wa_template_FAILED. If nothing queries them, rename to reflect the text send; if unsure, LEAVE THE NAMES ALONE and record the decision in findings.

Comment and docstring cleanup only, no logic change, at: line 767 ('But WhatsApp wd_menu template IS still sent on connect'), 958 (_is_auto_thumb_reaction_enabled docstring), 1015 (_handle_post_call_sip docstring), 1509-1513 (_send_incoming_call_sms docstring - the function itself has no caller but its SMS logic stays untouched), 1658 (_is_postcall_wa_enabled docstring).

DO NOT TOUCH, per the owner's explicit instruction: _SHARED_IVR_MENU (1906-1918), IVR_MENUS (1919-1922), IVR_DEFAULT_MENU (1925-1937), IVR_RESPONSES (1939-1989), _get_ivr_menu (1991-2009), _react_thumbs_up (972-1008), _is_auto_thumb_reaction_enabled (957-969), _is_postcall_wa_enabled (1657-1667), the SMS logic inside _send_incoming_call_sms, IVR_SMS_CONTENT, IVR_SMS_DLT_TEMPLATE_KEY, ORDER_SMS_CONTENT. _react_thumbs_up / _is_auto_thumb_reaction_enabled are imported directly by tests/test_calling.py::TestAutoThumbReaction and TestCallingAutoThumbConfig; _is_postcall_wa_enabled is patched at tests/test_calling.py:573 and reported by _get_config at 2254.

Do not change tests/test_calling.py beyond optionally rewording the wd_menu mention in the TestAutoThumbReaction docstring at line 493 - it patches _send_call_whatsapp_notification (at 158, 212, 386, 401) rather than asserting its payload. Verify during implementation that nothing in it asserts a template payload. Leave tests/test_outbound_whatsapp.py:218 alone (it passes a {'template': {'name': 'wd_menu'}} literal to _send_direct_api as an arbitrary transport fixture). Leave tests/test_notifications_domain.py alone (lines 576 and 616 assert lambda_utils/notifications/policy.py's WA_TEMPLATE_NAME default and rcsmenu - a different, gated subsystem this task does not name).

Confirm the handler still imports: load it by file path under a unique module name with boto3.resource and boto3.client patched, and confirm no exception. Do NOT deploy, do NOT run scripts/deploy_all_lambdas.py or scripts/snapstart_publish.py, do NOT move any live alias, do NOT delete the Lambda.

Record in findings: the final `grep -c wd_menu` result (must be 0), proof the four IVR symbols survive, whether the log event names were renamed and why, and that voice-in/obd/handler.py (lines 832, 928-990, 1018) and voice-in/c2c/handler.py (lines 356, 439-501, 529) STILL send the deleted wd_menu template and are therefore broken in production - out of this task's stated scope, must be reported to the owner.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -n '_SHARED_IVR_MENU\|IVR_MENUS\|IVR_DEFAULT_MENU\|IVR_RESPONSES\|_get_ivr_menu' amplify/functions/messaging/whatsapp-calling/handler.py` still finds all five, and IVR_RESPONSES still holds ivr_callback, ivr_support and ivr_ai
_send_menu_placeholder_text exists, uses _meta_api_call, and is called from both _send_call_whatsapp_notification and _handle_post_call_sip
_react_thumbs_up, _is_auto_thumb_reaction_enabled and _is_postcall_wa_enabled are all still defined and still called
The whatsapp-calling handler loads by file path with boto3 patched and raises nothing
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_calling.py tests/test_outbound_whatsapp.py tests/test_notifications_domain.py -q` passes with the same pass count as the recorded baseline
No deploy command was run, no live alias moved, no Lambda deleted
findings:
DONE. whatsapp-calling/handler.py: 2906 -> 2820 lines (86 removed net of the new helper).

GREP PROOF. `grep -c wd_menu amplify/functions/messaging/whatsapp-calling/handler.py` = 0. One literal survived the first pass inside the NEW helper's own docstring, where step 4 asked it to be recorded - acceptance criterion 1 and step 4 conflict, and the criterion wins, so the sentence was reworded to 'The WhatsApp menu template this replaced was deleted at Meta, and a template was what allowed a post-call message outside that window'. The information is preserved; the literal is not. `grep -n _send_ivr_menu <file>` exits 1, no matches, and a repo-wide grep (excluding .worktrees and .scratch) confirms the only remaining mentions are the planning docs and docs/notification-retirement-manifest.md:103, which lists it as a historically measured surface.

IVR SURVIVES UNTOUCHED, which was the owner's explicit constraint. `_SHARED_IVR_MENU` 1915, `IVR_MENUS` 1928, `IVR_DEFAULT_MENU` 1934, `IVR_RESPONSES` 1948, `_get_ivr_menu` 2000 (still called at 2109 from _auto_pickup_and_play), and `IVR_RESPONSES` still holds exactly ivr_ai / ivr_callback / ivr_support - read back off the imported module, not off a grep. Also untouched: _react_thumbs_up (972, called at 1114 and 2574), _is_auto_thumb_reaction_enabled (957, called at 984 and 2201), _is_postcall_wa_enabled (1666, called at 1107 and 2200), IVR_SMS_CONTENT, IVR_SMS_DLT_TEMPLATE_KEY, ORDER_SMS_CONTENT and every line of _send_incoming_call_sms's SMS logic.

WHAT REPLACED THE TEMPLATE. MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT at line 1486, next to IVR_SMS_CONTENT, verified byte-identical to the inbound handler's constant by importing both modules and comparing (True). _send_menu_placeholder_text at 1011, using _meta_api_call(f'{meta_id}/messages', 'POST', payload, phone_number_id=meta_id) - NOT _send_via_aws - so the returned wamid belongs to meta_id's own conversation and the existing auto-thumb keeps working. Called from both live sites: _handle_post_call_sip 1110 and _send_call_whatsapp_notification 2541 + 2547 (the retry).

LOG EVENT NAMES WERE NOT RENAMED, deliberately. `call_wa_template_sent` is named in docs/notification-retirement-manifest.md:22 as the identifier for this producer's notification surface, in an active document whose Phase 9 destructive steps are keyed on those rows. docs/ is outside this feature's owned paths, so a rename would desync a compliance document I cannot update in the same change. Fourteen days of CloudWatch history also carry the old name, so renaming splits the series. Nothing in scripts/ queries either name. Instead the now-false FIELD inside each payload changed: `'template': 'wd_menu'` became `'messageType': 'text'` on both call_wa_template_sent and call_wa_template_FAILED. The event names are stale and knowingly so; recorded here so the next owner of the manifest can rename both together.

OTHER DELIBERATE SUBSTITUTIONS. The CallNotifications put_item's whatsappTemplate is now 'none', not '' (an empty string is a DynamoDB hazard and 'none' reads as a fact). The WhatsAppOutboundTable and _store_notification_to_inbox contents are plain MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT with the '[wd_menu template]' and '[wd_menu template via {label}]' prefixes dropped. The 'wd_menu IS approved on {label}' troubleshoot text was dropped as false and replaced with the real failure mode: a plain text send needs an open 24-hour window. _handle_post_call_sip's 'all wd_menu sends failed, falling back to text' block is deleted entirely - it sent IVR_SMS_CONTENT via _send_via_aws, and there is no template to fall back from any more. Kept intact in both functions: the is_waba2 / send_from fan-out, the 2-second retry, first_msg_id, the _is_postcall_wa_enabled gate, _react_thumbs_up, put_call_breadcrumb, the outbound-table write, _send_disconnect_sms and the Sinch RCS step.

ACCEPTED CONSEQUENCE. The post-call WhatsApp follow-up is now a TEXT send, so it needs an open 24-hour customer-service window. A caller who has never messaged the business will NOT receive it - the template was precisely what allowed a send outside that window. Both call sites already treated the send as non-blocking, the failure is logged on call_wa_template_FAILED with that cause named in the troubleshoot field, and the post-call SMS (ivr-default DLT) and RCS paths are unaffected, so the caller is still reached on at least one channel. Net behaviour change is still positive: wd_menu is deleted at Meta, so every one of these sends fails 100% of the time today.

TESTS. Baseline before: `tests/test_calling.py tests/test_outbound_whatsapp.py tests/test_notifications_domain.py -q` = 229 passed. After: 229 passed, same count, as criterion 7 requires. Nothing in test_calling.py asserts a template payload - verified by grep: it patches _send_call_whatsapp_notification at 158, 212, 386 and 401 and never inspects its arguments. Only change there is the TestAutoThumbReaction docstring (wd_menu templates -> WhatsApp messages). tests/test_outbound_whatsapp.py:218 and tests/test_notifications_domain.py left alone as instructed. Full suite: 9 failed, 6788 passed, 1 skipped, 7 xfailed - byte-identical to FEAT-001's recorded post-state, so this change has ZERO test delta. The 9 failures (test_blog_ledger, test_checkout_website_handler, test_coupons_iam_and_table x3, test_email_verification_handler, test_gift_cards_iam_and_table x2, test_provision_checkout_contract) belong to other sessions and are not in this feature's blast radius.

IMPORT CHECK. Both handlers load by file path under unique module names with boto3.resource and boto3.client patched and raise nothing. ast.parse clean.

ONE LEFTOVER, REPORTED NOT FIXED. WA_TEMPLATE_VIDEO_URL (line 1498) is now an unreferenced module constant in this file - it existed only to fill the deleted template's VIDEO header. Deleting it is outside FEAT-002's step list and its acceptance criteria, so it was left in place rather than widened into scope. It is inert.

OUT OF SCOPE AND STILL BROKEN IN PRODUCTION - MUST REACH THE OWNER. Two other Lambdas still send the deleted wd_menu template on every CDR, so they fail 100% of the time right now: amplify/functions/messaging/voice-in/obd/handler.py (docstring 832, the send block 928-990, the DynamoDB content write 1018) and amplify/functions/messaging/voice-in/c2c/handler.py (356, 439-501, 529). Both build the same VIDEO-header template and both write '[wd_menu template] Thanks for contacting WECARE.DIGITAL!' into their tables as though it had been delivered - so the dashboard shows a message the customer never received. Note the path is amplify/functions/messaging/voice-in/{obd,c2c}/, not amplify/functions/voice/voice-in-{obd,c2c}/ as this feature's step 13 guessed. Separately, amplify/functions/messaging/outbound-whatsapp/handler.py:622 mentions wd_menu in a comment about VIDEO-header templates; harmless but stale. docs/notification-retirement-manifest.md measured 0 firings over 14 days for both voice-in CDR notification paths, so the live impact is probably nil in practice - but the code is wrong and should be fixed with the same placeholder in a follow-up.

NOT LIVE. No deploy of any kind: no scripts/deploy_all_lambdas.py, no scripts/snapstart_publish.py, no aws lambda update-function-code, no alias move, no Lambda deletion. wecare-whatsapp-calling sits behind a `live` alias, so this is $LATEST only and production keeps attempting the deleted template until the owner authorises a publish and alias move.

FILES: amplify/functions/messaging/whatsapp-calling/handler.py (edited), tests/test_calling.py (one docstring reworded, no assertion changed). inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py untouched - FEAT-001 owns it. Verified with `git status --short` as its own command before staging: only these two files modified, index clean.
